name: mcp-carte-ign
description: MCP App : carte OpenLayers avec fond Plan IGN v2 (WMTS Géoplateforme)

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && cross-env INPUT=mcp-app.html vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently "npm run watch:ui" "tsx --watch main.ts"
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run build && npm run serve
